title: Singapore banks test how to verify AI agents under PathFin.ai
summary: Green Link Digital Bank, AXS, Terminal 3 and HSBC Singapore ran a proof of concept under the Monetary Authority of Singapore's PathFin.ai programme. They tested an agent paying a biller, and a registered third-party agent acting for a corporate treasurer, with a trust layer checking each agent's identity.
whyItMatters: Know-your-agent checks are moving from policy papers into live bank trials in Asia.
